info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Marjoram Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Marjoram Recliner Catalog Management API streamlines the process of adding and managing detailed information about the Marjoram Recliner product. Through this endpoint, businesses can efficiently create comprehensive product details, enhancing visibility and accessibility within their catalog. This API is particularly beneficial for product managers and inventory specialists looking to maintain accurate and up-to-date catalogs for their sales teams. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure that their product offerings are well-documented and ready for customer engagement.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information for a Marjoram Recliner. You can specify various attributes and characteristics related to the recliner, which will help in managing and displaying information about the product effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit the details for the Marjoram recliner. The client must provide the necessary information in the specified format to create or update the recliner's details accurately.

200.description: Successful creation of marjoram recliner details.

CreateCatalogMarjoramReclinerDetailReque.title: Marjoram Recliner Request Body

marjoram_recliner_id.description: Unique identifier for the Marjoram recliner.

requestedBy.description: Name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The number of recliners being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit of the recliner.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Marjoram Recliner.

CreateCatalogMarjoramReclinerDetailReque.description: The request body schema for creating or updating a Marjoram Recliner operation.

ReclinerDimensions.title: Recliner Dimensions

width.description: Width of the recliner in the specified unit.

height.description: Height of the recliner in the specified unit.

unit.description: Measurement unit for the dimensions (e.g., cm, inches).

ReclinerDimensions.description: The dimensions of a recliner, including width, height, and measurement unit.

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating whether it was successful or not.

recordId.description: Unique identifier for the processed record.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: Count of records that matched the operation criteria.

pricing.description: The pricing details associated with the processed record.

CreateCatalogMarjoramReclinerDetailRespo.description: Response schema for the successful processing of a recliner details operation.

net.description: The net amount before any taxes are applied.

currency.description: The currency in which the pricing is specified.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates whether the given price includes tax.

Pricing.description: Represents pricing details, including net price, currency, and tax inclusion.

content-type.description: The MIME type of the content returned in the response. It indicates the format of the data that the client can expect.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value can help in assessing the performance of the operation.
